description: React component implementing an interactive mind map visualization with zooming, panning, node selection, and rendering edges and nodes in SVG.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number between a minimum and maximum value.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to string, trims it, and handles null or undefined values.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Computes a radial-ish layout for nodes, centered at a specified node.

methods.name: getNodeColor
methods.description: Determines node fill color based on its status (center, selected, dimmed).

methods.name: getNodeStroke
methods.description: Determines node stroke color based on its status.
